propositions: Completion verification fails verdict-less due to runaway duplicate tool calls, request-budget exhaustion, and flat 100K-char recovery context ceiling that rejects live tickets larger than bound
Recovery path fans out one isolated LLM run per criterion, causing 440+ requests with 2.67M context chars re-sent for multi-criterion tickets
Flat context bound in completion_recovery.py:68 refuses tickets with append-only growing context (live c9f7 121,147 chars exceeds 100K ceiling)

Per-criterion recovery verdicts must be banked incrementally and batched into successor runs with deterministic no-LLM fallback to ensure typed failures with banked progress end in full-coverage verdicts
Duplicate read-only tool calls within agentic runs execute repeatedly instead of being memoized, causing waste across all tool-bearing workflows
File reads in live verification are 67-82% redundant and can be pre-loaded from ranked file_impact contents under a per-file full/skeleton manifest
